AppPalette.light, AppTypography, AppSpacing, AppRadii — as implemented in batamart_app/lib/core/theme
Your money is held safely and only released
once you confirm the item arrived.
STATUS CHIP — HAIRLINE RING, NEVER A SOLID PILL
LABEL ABOVE THE FIELD, NEVER A FLOATING LABEL
STAT RAIL — HAIRLINE GRID, TABULAR FIGURES
SLAB — STAYS DARK IN BOTH THEMES
RADII — SHARP BY RULE: SM / MD / LG 2PX, XL 3PX, PILL 999PX
ICONS — LUCIDE, OUTLINE ONLY, STROKE 2/24, SIZES 10–24
ELEVATION — NONE. STRUCTURE COMES FROM THE 1PX RULE, NOT SHADOW.
